# What's new in Dynamics 365 Customer Service

Welcome to Dynamics 365 Customer Service.

Explore new and upcoming features in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. Learn about feature details, release timelines, and availability in [Release plans for Dynamics 365](/en-us/dynamics365/release-plans/).

# Get started with Copilot Service workspace

Copilot Service workspace helps customer service representatives (service representatives or representatives) increase productivity with a browser-like, tabbed experience. Service representatives can use the app to work on multiple cases and conversations. It's a modern, customizable, high-productivity application that allows them to work on multiple sessions at a time in a single workspace.

The application uses artificial intelligence in productivity tools like Smart Assist to identify similar cases and relevant articles, thereby boosting representative productivity. Features such as scripts and macros provide representatives with guidance and resources to automate repetitive tasks to achieve a great customer experience.

Learn more about licensing and system requirements in [Copilot Service workspace system requirements](customer-service-workspace-system-requirements).

**Set up Omnichannel in Copilot Service workspace**

With the Dynamics 365 Customer Service Digital Messaging add-on, the representative who work on cases can also engage with customers via channels like Live Chat, voice, and SMS without leaving the Copilot Service workspace app.

![Screenshot of the enhanced multisession Copilot Service workspace](../media/csw-default-overview.png)

## Copilot Service workspace sessions and tabs

Copilot Service workspace allows representatives to work on multiple sessions at a time in a single app while keeping the work organized.

- Representatives can work on up to nine sessions and within a session, they can open up to 10 tabs.
- A new session starts when a representative opens a case from the **Home** session or accepts an incoming conversation.
- If the representative opens the customer record from a session, a new tab opens in the same session.
- Representatives can select the hamburger icon to access the site map.
- When a representative opens a page from the site map, the page loads in the current focused session.

### Navigate sessions and tabs

The following table gives an overview of the multisession navigation:

| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Open a record from the Home session | Record opens in a new session. |
| Open a record from the Global search | Record opens in a new session. |
| Open a record from the retrieved search records | Record opens in a focused session. |
| Open a record using the Quick Create notification | Record opens in a new session. |
| Create a new record | Record opens in a new session. |
| Open a record from the timeline | Record opens in a new tab in the focused session. |
| Open a record from a form lookup | Record opens in a new tab in the focused session. |
| Open a view from the site map | View opens in a new tab in the focused session. |
| Open a dashboard from the site map | Dashboard opens in a new tab in the focused session. |
| Expand **Recent** in the site map | You can see records and views opened from the **anchor** tab only. |

### Session restore (preview)

If your administrator turned on session restore, key entities in Copilot Service workspace reload automatically if your browser refreshes. Without session restore, when a browser refreshes or reconnects, Copilot Service workspace reloads only the home page.

Session restore automatically restores cases, accounts, and their associated application tabs without requiring you to manually reopen them. Focus is restored to the last session or application tab in view. After the presence is loaded, conversations, including calls and chats, are reinstated.

Learn more in [Enable session restore to automatically reopen sessions and tabs (preview)](../administer/enable-session-restore).

### Use the Inbox

If your administrator turned on the inbox for your profile, you can select the **Inbox** tab to view all the cases, conversations, and activities that are assigned to you. Use the inbox to work on high-velocity tasks. You can also promote inbox sessions to regular sessions when you need more time to resolve a case or complete a conversation.

The asynchronous channels available in the conversation inbox are:

- SMS
- persistent chat
- Facebook
- WeChat
- LINE
- WhatsApp
- Microsoft Teams

Learn more in [Configure the inbox view](../administer/configure-inbox).

### Use the productivity pane with Smart Assist

When you work on a case, the productivity pane on the right side of the Copilot Service workspace displays intelligence-driven suggestions to help you. The productivity pane uses Smart Assist to suggest related cases and knowledge articles that might be relevant to the case you're working on. There are also scripts that guide you through a consistent series of steps with potentially automated actions through macros.

Learn more in [Productivity pane](../use/csw-productivity-pane).

## Work with cases, activities, knowledge articles, and email templates

On the Customer Service Representative Dashboard, here are some of the actions you can do:

- View cases and activities assigned to you
- View cases available to work on
- Create, delete, and filter cases and activities from the workspace

### Customize the representative experience with Copilot Service admin center

Experience profiles enable you to create targeted app experiences for representatives and supervisors, and are an alternative to building and maintaining custom apps. With the experience profiles, administrators can create custom profiles with specific session templates, conversation channels, and productivity tools. These profiles can then be assigned to users.

Learn more in [Experience profiles](../administer/overview).

## Considerations

Here are a few things to note when you use Copilot Service workspace in your organization:

- We recommend that you have only one browser instance accessing the app.
- `XRM.Navigation.openForm` and `Xrm.Navigation.navigateTo`APIs have a similar navigation as the multisession app. For example:
    - A new session is initiated if you open a form through `XRM.Navigation.openForm` from Home.
    - A new tab in the focused session is initiated if you open a form through `XRM.Navigation.openForm` from a case session.
- Opening a WebResource through `Xrm.Navigation.openWebResource` opens a new browser window but doesn't remove the navigation and command bars. You can programmatically open web resources as session tabs using the `Microsoft.Apm.createTab` method. Learn more in [createTab method](../develop/reference/methods/createtab).
- You can open sessions and tabs using Microsoft.Apm APIs. Learn more in [App profile manager JavaScript API Reference](../develop/microsoft-apm).
- The multisession capabilities are supported in the Copilot Service workspace app only. You won't be able to navigate across multiple sessions in a custom app or a copy of the Copilot Service workspace app in your environment.

### Limitations

The following limitations apply to Copilot Service workspace:

- When you switch between tabs or sessions:
    - Subgrid controls don't retain the filter or sort conditions.
    - Web resources, form components, custom pages, and third-party websites don't retain the state of the page. For example, form components might retain unsaved values for text fields but not for lookup fields.
    - When you change the status record in a tab, the corresponding record that's open in a grid or subgrid of another tab doesn't refresh automatically.
- Copilot Service workspace isn't supported in mobile devices, Unified Service Desk, Microsoft Teams, and with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (on-premises).

## Deprecated Customer Service workspace layout

The legacy layout is deprecated and was removed in October 2023.

[![Screenshot of the default Copilot Service workspace, with items labeled according to the legend in the table](../media/csw-overview-mini.png)](../media/csw-overview.png#lightbox)

### Turn off the close session dialog

1. With Copilot Service workspace open, press the F12 key to open the developer tools window.
2. In the console window, enter the following command: `Xrm.Utility.getGlobalContext().saveSettingValue("msdyn_SuppressSessionCloseWarning",true)`
3. Refresh the app page.

# Manage Copilot features in Customer Service

Copilot in Customer Service provides real-time AI assistance that helps customer service representatives (service representatives or representatives) automate tasks, resolve cases faster, and deliver better customer experiences. When you turn on Copilot features, representatives can respond to questions, compose emails, draft chat responses, and summarize cases and conversations in the Copilot Service workspace app.

This article helps administrators:

- Identify which setting controls the Copilot scenario they want to turn on.
- Confirm prerequisites, licensing, and region requirements before setup.
- Enable, configure, and validate Copilot features for representatives.

Note

Summarize conversations is available in Copilot Service workspace only. To use Copilot features in Customer Service Hub and custom apps, you must also complete the steps in Enable Copilot features in Power Platform admin center.

## How Copilot features are delivered

Copilot features in Dynamics 365 Customer Service are powered by Microsoft 365 Copilot and exposed in Customer Service apps such as Copilot Service workspace. Copilot features use customer service data, such as cases, customer records, and interactions, to help representatives retrieve information, generate responses, and complete actions without leaving their workflow.

Some Copilot capabilities are delivered through Copilot agents, such as Service Agent. These agents extend Copilot with customer service–specific functionality that helps representatives summarize cases, retrieve knowledge, and perform actions.

You manage Copilot features in two admin centers:

- **Power Platform admin center**: Turn on AI-powered Copilot features for an environment, and manage data movement across regions and data sharing.
- **Copilot Service admin center**: Opt in, choose the Copilot experiences that representatives use, configure Copilot agents, and manage translation and transcript settings.

## Choose the right setting for your scenario

Use the following table to find the setting that controls what you want to do. Then go to the linked section for detailed steps.

| I want to... | Admin center | Path or setting | Section in this article |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Turn on Copilot features for an environment | Power Platform admin center | **Copilot** > **Settings** > **Copilot** (under **Dynamics 365 Customer Service**) > select the environment > **Edit setting** > **Enable AI-powered Copilot features** | Enable Copilot features in Power Platform admin center |
| Use Copilot features in Customer Service Hub or custom apps | Power Platform admin center | **Enable AI-powered Copilot features** for the environment | Enable Copilot features in Power Platform admin center |
| Use Copilot in a region where it isn't available in region by default | Power Platform admin center | Allow data movement across regions | Region availability and data movement |
| Fix throttling or unavailability caused by capacity constraints | Power Platform admin center | Allow data movement across regions | Understand cross-region data movement |
| Let Microsoft capture and review Copilot data to improve features | Power Platform admin center | Data sharing for Dynamics 365 Copilot features | Data sharing for Copilot features |
| Accept the terms and continue setup | Copilot Service admin center | **Support experience** > **Productivity** > **Copilot settings**, or **Operations** > **Insights** > **Summaries** > **Opt in** | Opt in to Copilot features |
| Stop using Copilot features | Copilot Service admin center | **Support experience** > **Productivity** > **Copilot settings**, or **Operations** > **Insights** > **Summaries** | Opt out of Copilot features |
| Choose Copilot immersive or Copilot side pane for representatives | Copilot Service admin center | **Support experience** > **Productivity** > **Copilot settings** > **Manage** | Configure Copilot experiences for representatives |
| Control which representatives get which Copilot features in Copilot Service workspace | Copilot Service admin center | Experience profiles | Make Copilot available to representatives |
| Configure Copilot behavior, email settings, and prompts for representatives | Copilot Service admin center | **Agents within Copilot** > **Customer Support** > **Settings** | Configure Customer Support agent settings |
| Manage admin prompts, user access, and tools and knowledge for administrators | Copilot Service admin center | **Agents within Copilot** > **Admin Management** > **Settings** | Configure Admin Management agent settings |
| Let representatives translate responses | Copilot Service admin center | **Copilot settings** > **Translation using Copilot** | Let representatives translate responses |
| Record representative interactions with Copilot for usage analysis | Copilot Service admin center | **Copilot settings** > **Support experience data** | Record representative interactions with Copilot |
| Give users with custom security roles access to Copilot | Power Platform admin center | Security roles and privileges | Assign roles and privileges |

## Prerequisites

Before you set up Copilot features, ensure that you:

- Have the System Administrator role.
- Meet the licensing requirements for using the feature with production environments. Learn more in the [Dynamics 365 Licensing Guide](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=866544).
- Use an environment geography that supports Copilot in region, or you allowed data movement across regions. Learn more in Region availability and data movement.
- Verify that the languages your representatives use are supported. Learn more in [Language support for AI-based analytics and insights in Customer Service](cs-region-availability-service-limits#language-support-for-ai-based-analytics-and-insights-in-customer-service).
- Assign representatives the Customer Service Representative role, or a custom role that includes the required privileges. Learn more in Assign roles and privileges.

## Region availability and data movement

The option to enable Copilot AI features is available in region by default to customers with environments that have the following geographies for data processing and storage:

- United States
- Australia
- India
- United Kingdom
- Government cloud regions (GCC, GCC High)

*In region* means within the geographical region of your Power Platform or Dynamics 365 environment.

For Europe, data movement for Copilot features is turned on by default.

For all other regions, you must [allow data movement across regions](/en-us/power-platform/admin/geographical-availability-copilot) in Power Platform admin center before you can opt in to use Copilot.

![Screenshot of the generative AI features settings in Power Platform admin center.](../media/ppac-enable-gen-ai.png)

The respond to questions, compose an email, and summarize cases and conversations features are generally available in the North America region only. These features are in preview in the rest of the supported regions. Learn more in [Region availability](cs-region-availability-service-limits#region-availability-of-analytics-and-insights).

### Understand cross-region data movement

Copilot feature performance depends on the regional availability of Azure OpenAI services. The following table describes when you must [allow data movement across regions](/en-us/power-platform/admin/geographical-availability-copilot) in Power Platform admin center before you can opt in to use Copilot.

| Scenario | Data movement required? |
| --- | --- |
| Azure OpenAI capacity is available in the same region as your tenant. | No |
| Azure OpenAI capacity isn't available in your tenant region. | Yes |
| Azure OpenAI capacity is available in your tenant region, but has fallback to external regions. | Optional. If you don't allow data movement, you might have performance issues, such as throttling or unavailability due to capacity constraints. |

Note

Data movement across regions is turned on by default in Power Platform admin center.

## Supported languages

Learn about supported languages for Copilot in [Language support for AI-based analytics and insights in Customer Service](cs-region-availability-service-limits#language-support-for-ai-based-analytics-and-insights-in-customer-service).

## Data sharing for Copilot features

You can turn on data sharing for Dynamics 365 Copilot features in Power Platform admin center. Data sharing allows Microsoft to capture and manually review customer data, including, but not limited to, users' natural language inputs, outputs, and related telemetry to build, improve, and validate Microsoft's features, services, machine learning models, and related systems for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform Copilot AI features.

Microsoft doesn't use customer data to train Azure OpenAI Service foundation models. Learn more in [Tenant settings](/en-us/power-platform/admin/tenant-settings) and [FAQ for optional data sharing for Copilot AI features in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform](/en-us/power-platform/faqs-copilot-data-sharing).

## Enable Copilot features in Power Platform admin center

Turn on Copilot features for your environment. This step is required for representatives to use Copilot features in Customer Service Hub and custom apps.

1. Sign in to [Power Platform admin center](https://admin.powerplatform.microsoft.com).
2. In the site map, select **Copilot**.
3. Under **Dynamics 365 Customer Service**, select **Settings** > **Copilot**.
4. Search for and select your environment, and then select **Edit setting**.
5. Select the **Enable AI-powered Copilot features** checkbox, and then save your changes.

## Opt in to Copilot features

In Copilot Service admin center, the [**Copilot settings**](/en-us/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/copilot-enable-help-pane) and [**Summaries**](/en-us/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/copilot-enable-summary) pages display the following information:

- A message to allow data movement across regions, if your region doesn't have Copilot features available by default.
- A link to Power Platform admin center, where you can allow data movement across regions.
- The data movement status.
- A link to review the terms and conditions.

To opt in:

1. In Copilot Service admin center, go to one of the following pages:

    - **Support experience** > **Productivity** > **Copilot settings**
    - **Operations** > **Insights** > **Summaries**
2. Review the data movement status. If data movement is required for your region and isn't allowed, use the link to allow data movement across regions in Power Platform admin center.
3. Review the terms and conditions.
4. Select **Opt in**.

    [![Screenshot of the Copilot settings page with the data movement status and the Opt in button.](../media/copilot-enable-opt-in-mini.png)](../media/copilot-enable-opt-in.png#lightbox)

## Opt out of Copilot features

1. In Copilot Service admin center, go to one of the following pages:
    - **Support experience** > **Productivity** > **Copilot settings**
    - **Operations** > **Insights** > **Summaries**
2. Opt out of Copilot features.

Important

When you opt out, the application erases the training data. To use the features again, you must consent to the terms of use and opt in.

## Make Copilot available to representatives

How representatives get access to Copilot depends on the app they use.

| App | How access is granted |
| --- | --- |
| Copilot Service workspace | Turn on Copilot features in experience profiles. By default, representatives you add to the default experience profiles can use Copilot features. |
| Customer Service Hub | When you turn on the feature, it's available to all representatives. |

To limit the Copilot features that specific representatives can use in Copilot Service workspace:

1. Create a custom experience profile and turn on only the required Copilot features.
2. Assign the custom experience profile to the representatives.

Learn more in [Add users to experience profiles](add-profile-default).

## Configure Copilot experiences for representatives

1. In Copilot Service admin center, under **Support experience**, select **Productivity**.
2. For **Copilot settings**, select **Manage**.
3. Select the checkboxes for the Copilot experiences you want representatives to use:
    - **Copilot immersive**
    - **Copilot side pane**
4. Save your changes.

## Configure Customer Support agent settings

To manage how Copilot behaves for your representatives, configure the **Customer Support** agent.

1. In Copilot Service admin center, in the **Agents within Copilot** section, select **Settings** next to **Customer Support**. The **Customer Support** page appears.
2. Configure the required Copilot features for representatives on the following tabs:
    - **Overview**
    - **Immersive settings**
    - **Email settings**
    - **Prompts**
    - **Extend agent**

Learn more about the Customer Support agent and the settings on each tab in [Enable features in Copilot](/en-us/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/copilot-enable-help-pane).

## Configure Admin Management agent settings

The **Admin Management** (preview) agent is an optional Copilot agent that gives administrators a centralized way to manage administrative prompts, control user access, and connect tools and knowledge through Copilot Studio.

1. In Copilot Service admin center, in the **Agents within Copilot** section, select **Settings** next to **Admin Management**. The **Admin Management** page appears.
2. Configure the required Copilot features for administrators on the following tabs:
    - **Overview**
    - **Prompts**
    - **User access**
3. To manage tools and knowledge for this agent, use the links to **Copilot Studio** on the **Overview** tab.

Learn more in [Enable features in Copilot](/en-us/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/copilot-enable-help-pane).

## Let representatives translate responses

1. On the **Copilot settings** page, go to **Translation using Copilot**.
2. Select **Let representatives translate responses using Copilot**.

Representatives can then select from the languages configured in Dynamics 365.

## Record representative interactions with Copilot

1. On the **Copilot settings** page, go to the **Support experience data** section.
2. Select **Record transcripts of representative interactions with Copilot**.

Use the recorded data to understand usage patterns and improve Copilot performance. You can also [download the data](../develop/download-copilot-transcript-data) to analyze knowledge sources and build usage reports.

## Assign roles and privileges

By default, only users with the Customer Service Representative role can use Copilot features. If your users have custom security roles, ensure those roles include the following privileges.

| Table | Name | Create | Read | Write | Append | Append To |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Copilot event | msdyn_copilotevent | Yes | Yes | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Copilot interaction | msdyn_copilotinteraction | Yes | Yes | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable |
| Copilot interaction data | msdyn_copilotinteractiondata | Yes | Yes | Yes | Not applicable | Yes |
| Agent Preference For Copilot | msdyn_copilotagentpreference | Yes | Yes | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| AI Model | msdyn_aimodel | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| AI Template | msdyn_aitemplate | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| ConversationInsight | msdyn_conversationinsight | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Copilot Transcript Data | msdyn_copilottranscriptdata | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Not applicable |
| App profile | msdyn_appconfiguration | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Pane tool configuration | msdyn_panetoolconfiguration | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Productivity pane configuration | msdyn_paneconfiguration | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Pane tab configuration | msdyn_panetabconfiguration | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Organization Setting | organizationsetting | Not applicable | Yes | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |

Note

Ensure that your custom security roles include **Miscellaneous privileges** > **prvIntelligenceUsage** so that users can access Copilot. Learn more in [Security roles and privileges](/en-us/power-platform/admin/security-roles-privileges).

### Access levels for the Copilot event table

Set the following access levels for the Copilot event (msdyn_copilotevent) privileges, based on the type of custom role.

| Custom role type | Privilege | Access level |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Representative | `prvReadmsdyn_copilotevent` | Basic |
| Representative | `prvWritemsdyn_copilotevent` | Basic |
| Representative | `prvCreatemsdyn_copilotevent` | Global |
| Customer service representative manager | `prvReadmsdyn_copilotevent` | Global |
| Customer service representative manager | `prvCreatemsdyn_copilotevent` | Global |
| Customer service representative manager | `prvWritemsdyn_copilotevent` | Global |

## Validate your setup

After you complete setup, verify that Copilot works as expected.

1. In Power Platform admin center, confirm that **Enable AI-powered Copilot features** is selected for your environment.
2. In Copilot Service admin center, on the **Copilot settings** page, confirm that you're opted in and that the data movement status meets your region's requirements.
3. Confirm that the Copilot experiences you want (**Copilot immersive**, **Copilot side pane**, or both) are selected.
4. Confirm that the representatives you're testing with are assigned to an experience profile that has Copilot features turned on.
5. Sign in to Copilot Service workspace as a test representative, open a case or conversation, and use a Copilot feature, such as asking a question or summarizing the case.
6. If representatives use Customer Service Hub or a custom app, sign in to that app as a test representative and confirm that Copilot features are available.
7. If you use custom security roles, sign in as a user with that role and confirm that Copilot features work.
